title: identity taxonomy v6 — frozen derivation semantics with schema-v3 evidence contract
supersession: v6 supersedes v5 for active release discovery; derivation semantics unchanged, evidence contract upgraded to schema-v3 row16 + signal4 + edge2 bindings and discriminative PDF anchors.

fields.signal_id: stable within the method path; every control edge references exactly one
fields.evidence: REQUIRED locator (canon/tex quote or structural) grounding form+lifecycle+uses

signal_schema.note: a non-reward control signal (e.g. AutoTTS code-controller state observations) is coded form=none/source=state_observation — the phase conflation the batch-A adjudicator observed is now expressible instead of averaged away

fields.signal_id: REQUIRED — the signal instance exercising control
fields.signal_use: must be a member of the referenced signal's uses
fields.decision_right: must be a member of the row's decision_rights
fields.signal_lifecycle: OPTIONAL; if present MUST equal the referenced signal's lifecycle (mismatch = validator failure, edge invalid)

control_edge_schema.validity: edge VALID iff referenced signal exists AND signal_use ∈ signal.uses AND decision_right ∈ row.decision_rights AND (signal_use -> decision_right) ∈ allowed_relations AND locator+semantics non-empty AND (edge lifecycle absent or == signal lifecycle); LIVE iff signal.lifecycle==online_step OR (signal.lifecycle==terminal AND decision_right ∈ {synthesize, stop})

allowed_relations_provenance: unchanged from v4 (seed = v7-review §4.3 + four anchored evidence-driven additions, iso-adj-A adjudicated LEGIT with the stop_budget->tool_call non-generalization caveat); extension discipline unchanged (new relation types need a dated supersession + anchor row + adjudication)

derived_v5.signal_is_reward: s.lifecycle ∈ {online_step, terminal} AND s.form ∈ reward_forms AND s.uses ∩ reward_uses ≠ ∅
derived_v5.data_access_strict_bits: all seven access bits are EXACTLY false AND internal_visibility==api_only; any 'unknown' value fails the conjunction WITHOUT being recorded as false (tri-state, v8-review §5.5)
derived_v5.is_s0_core_compatible: strict AND core_topology ∈ topology_policy AND core_native_modality ∈ {audio_native, omni_native}
derived_v5.is_rq_sys_control_compatible: control_horizon==sequential AND ∃ signal s AND ∃ VALID LIVE edge e: signal_is_reward(s) AND e.signal_id == s.signal_id AND e.signal_use ∈ reward_uses — the reward property and the control edge must come from the SAME signal instance AND the edge's own use must itself be a reward use (v8-review §4.1–4.3 kills the different-signal splice; the use-granularity clause is the CE-v3 patch: an inert reward-qualifying use elsewhere on the signal cannot promote a pure synthesis edge, fixture __fixture__cross_use_synth_splice)
derived_v5.reward_guided_selection: candidate_pool_exists==true AND selection_policy ∈ {scored_select, tournament_select} AND selection_object != none AND ∃ signal s: signal_is_reward(s) AND {select, prune} ∩ s.uses ≠ ∅ — same-signal, live-lifecycle; offline_calibration scoring can never qualify (v8-review §4.4)

required_evidence_contract.principle: Every load-bearing encoded value is field-bound and source-resolved before derivation.

evidence_kinds.canon: verbatim quote inside the work's own canonical DFS section
evidence_kinds.tex: verbatim (TeX-normalized) quote inside the pinned eprint
evidence_kinds.pdf_page: page number within the pinned PDF's page range PLUS an anchor token found on that page's extracted text
evidence_kinds.absence: negative-proposition adjudication: structured note + explicit scope of what was inspected (machine floor = presence + value binding; semantic truth is bound by the adjudication row-hash)

adjudication_binding.rule: adjudication_row_sha256 = sha256 over the canonical JSON of the method-path row EXCLUDING adjudication fields; reconciliation recomputes it — ANY post-adjudication change to a load-bearing row (including a single horizon flip or a value+evidence double-flip) invalidates the adjudication and fails closed (v8-review §5.2 killer)
adjudication_binding.actors: unchanged from v4 (stable actor ids, coder != semantic_adjudicator on load-bearing rows, conflict_queue for disagreements, owner spot-check at signing)

release_binding.rule: active release discovery resolves through wiki/survey/current/manifest.json; historical bound artifacts remain available through explicit legacy regression.

cross_platform_contract.rule: all registered asset paths resolve through scripts/survey/sf_asset_path.py; acceptance = Windows AND wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 (~/.venvs/speechrl, Python 3.12) produce the same verdict, same occupancy, and byte-identical generator output (v8-review §6.3)

killer_and_acceptance_contract.K1_native_audio_no_reward: audio-native strict core without reward is not a candidate
killer_and_acceptance_contract.K2_reward_tool_stop_no_pool: evidenced same-signal tool/stop edges without a K pool IS a candidate (omni strict)
killer_and_acceptance_contract.K3_online_binary_verifiable: verifiable online binary counts as reward
killer_and_acceptance_contract.K4_disjoint_no_edge: select+memory_write with no edge is not rq-compatible
killer_and_acceptance_contract.K5_fabricated_edge: edge outside allowed_relations never confers rq
killer_and_acceptance_contract.K6_terminal_only_selection: final-answer selection + unrelated sequential right is not rq-compatible
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A1_edge_signal_lifecycle_mismatch: edge lifecycle != referenced signal lifecycle -> validator failure, edge invalid (v8-review §4.2)
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A2_different_signal_splice: terminal reward + online non-reward route edge -> rq FALSE (v8-review §4.3)
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A4_terminal_reward_rights: terminal reward select edges may target synthesize/stop only
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A5_multi_signal_identity: multi-signal rows (AutoTTS state+consensus, Selective TTS stage+final judges) derive from per-signal identity, never a flattened average
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A6_rgs_same_signal: reward_guided_selection requires the same live reward signal with select/prune plus a real pool and selection operator
killer_and_acceptance_contract.A8_cross_use_splice: CE-v3 (non-implementer): a reward signal whose ONLY live edge exercises a non-reward use (e.g. synthesize_input) must NOT be rq-compatible — enforced by the use-granularity clause; fixtures live in 2026-07-19-sf-independent-counterexamples-v3.json (incl. overlapping-uses/rgs-cross-signal/pool-unknown/strict-unknown regression guards)

single_write_pipeline: unchanged from v4 flow (sidecar -> generator -> coding v6 -> reconciliation -> occupancy) with schema v2 sidecars; coding v6 remains a GENERATED projection (hand edits fail byte-equality)
schema: schema-v3: row16 + signal4 + edge2 evidence bindings; discriminative PDF anchors
